annotations.title: Bitcoin SegWit/Taproot UTXO Dust Consolidation & Fee-Window Planner

description: Analyzes a set of Bitcoin UTXO balances in satoshis to compute exact vByte transaction weight, identify uneconomical dust inputs, and recommend whether to consolidate now or hold. Use when optimizing on-chain Bitcoin treasury UTXO sets to minimize long-term miner fee drag; for fetching current live Bitcoin mempool sat/vB feerates alone, use estimate_bitcoin_mempool_fees instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'utxos_sats_json' ('script_type' defaults to 'p2wpkh_segwit'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (80 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

script_type.description: Bitcoin input script type determining vByte weight per input; defaults to 'p2wpkh_segwit' when omitted.

utxos_sats_json.description: JSON array or comma-separated list of UTXO values in satoshis (e.g. '[1200, 45000, 85000]').

name: plan_bitcoin_utxo_consolidation

estimated_consolidation_vbytes.description: Total virtual byte (vB) size of the consolidation transaction.

high_fee_dust_utxos.description: Count of UTXOs whose input weight costs more than 3% of their value.

title: Bitcoin SegWit/Taproot UTXO Dust Consolidation & Fee-Window Planner
